jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Full Stack (.NET/React) (all genders)
jobs.description:
General information:

As part of our development team, you will be responsible for the further development of our enterprise software for marketing automation. With this solution, our more than 200 customers from a wide range of industries control their digital marketing campaigns at every touchpoint - automated, individualized and intelligent based on AI.

Core task / activity: Product development full-time or part-time

Tech Stack

Backend: C# with .NET/ .NET Core
Frontend: React & TypeScript
CI/CD: Azure DevOps
Environment: MS Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Your mission:

You take on a leading role within the development team, mentoring colleagues, sharing your expertise, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence
You actively scout, evaluate, and champion emerging technologies, frameworks, and best practices, driving innovation and shaping the strategic technical direction of our products
You lead by example in architectural decisions and complex problem-solving, taking ownership of cross-cutting initiatives and ensuring the long-term scalability, maintainability and quality of our software solutions
As part of our agile software development according to Scrumban, you will create complex software systems in the C# programming language on the Microsoft .NET platform and work with the latest technologies such Claude Code
You will advance our company's capabilities in agentic coding, shaping the future of AI-driven development
You will be responsible for everything from conception and development to integration into our system landscape, using many Azure DevOps options: version management with Git, test plans, build and release
You will actively engage with current cloud technologies and develop cloud-based web applications with real-time requirements and enable the hosting of our web applications in MS Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS)
You work on framework conditions of the software development process such as design, planning, estimates and code reviews and see yourself as an advisor to the development team consisting of Product Owner, Full Stack Developers, SQA Engineers and the Helpdesk as a support team for our customers

Your profile:

Excellent C# skills with a deep understanding of modern software design and object-oriented principles
Strong experience with both relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) database technologies
Proven experience working with cloud platforms and developing cloud-native applications
Solid working knowledge of Docker and container-based deployment
Comprehensive expertise in both current .NET versions and the legacy .NET Framework, enabling you to work confidently across modern and established codebases
Experience with AI tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot **or** OpenAI Codex
Good communication and teamwork skills
Strong proficiency in English, both written and spoken

About Us

With over 20 years of experience, DYMATRIX is the leading German software, solution and service provider for data-driven customer experience based on AI. With the DYMATRIX Customer Experience Platform (CXP), we create outstanding experiences for your customers that contribute to your company's success.

Our customers benefit from our experience and expertise from more than 2,000 projects for over 200 customers. Medium-sized companies, large DAX-listed companies, specialist providers and market leaders from a wide range of industries appreciate working with us. Since 2024, our platform has been supplemented by personalization, recommendation and web analytics solutions from the former econda GmbH.

The success of our customers is our top priority. With the DYMATRIX Customer Experience Platform, together we create an excellent customer experience - at all touchpoints along the customer journey - made in Germany, guaranteed GDPR and Privacy Shield compliant!

Kommunikationsstärke, Eigeninitiative sowie eine pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

jobs.title: C# Engineer
jobs.description:
This is an hourly-paid, fully remote contractor role where you will review AI-generated responses and/or generate C#/.NET engineering content, evaluating reasoning quality and step-by-step problem-solving. You will assess solutions for accuracy, clarity, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in methodology or conceptual understanding; fact-check technical claims; and rate/compare multiple responses based on correctness and reasoning quality. You will also produce high-quality explanations and model solutions that demonstrate correct methods and clear communication. This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs—your work directly helps improve the world’s premier AI models.

Important

There is no immediate project for this role; however, if qualified, you will be among the first experts we reach out to when relevant opportunities arise. This will also provide you with access to future projects available through our expert network.

Key Responsibilities

Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.
Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance the model's accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.
Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI models for potential inaccuracies or biases, validating their reliability across use cases.

Your Profile

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
2+ years of professional experience using C#.
Strong experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem (ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, async/await, LINQ).
Knowledge of relational databases and data access patterns (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL; EF Core and/or Dapper).
Experience with modern engineering practices and tooling (Git, CI/CD, Docker).
Strong advantage: experience solving Medium–Hard algorithmic problems (e.g., LeetCode/HackerRank-style).
Strong English writing skills; Minimum C1 English proficiency.
Highly detail-oriented, able to spot subtle logical/technical issues and explain corrections clearly.
Preferred: prior experience with AI data training, evaluation, annotation, or technical QA of model outputs.
Able to work as an hourly, remote contractor with reliable internet and consistent availability.

jobs.title: Windows Engineer | Mid-Senior | C#/.NET
jobs.description:
At Nord Security’s B2B team, we build cybersecurity products that enable businesses to protect themselves and their data.

From product and engineering to sales, marketing, and data — our teams work closely together to deliver secure, scalable solutions trusted by companies around the world.

Your impact?
Empowering businesses everywhere to keep their people, systems, and data safe.

Main Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Windows applications and system components - Services, IPC, networking, GUI, APIs, and drivers.
Collaborate with designers, QA, and the Product Owner to extend and improve the functionality of our product, from early technical discussions to final delivery.
Take ownership of features end-to-end: research solutions, write clean and maintainable code, and see your work through to release.
Contribute to architectural decisions and help shape the technical direction.

Core Requirements

Proven Experience: minimum 3+ years of experience in Windows application development using .NET.
Windows API Proficiency: deep familiarity with Windows API, including experience with multithreading, inter-process communication, and memory management.
Debugging & Troubleshooting: excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills with experience using Windows debugging tools.
Experience in Agile & Git.
Profound English language skills.

Bonus Points For

Good understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), VPN technologies (OpenVPN, WireGuard, IPSec), and network security principles.
Good understanding of security best practices and a commitment to writing secure code.

What we offer

Sharpen your edge: training, mentorship, and room to grow — always.
Take the time you need: extra vacation days, sick days, and time off when life calls.
Get premium healthcare: private health insurance in Lithuania and Poland — fully covered.

Own your fitness: in-house gyms, sport cards, online workouts, and personal guidance — on us.

Work from anywhere: work from wherever keeps you in the zone.
Celebrate your milestones: birthdays, weddings, and new family members — all deserve a gift.
Parent with ease: children’s summer camps and flexibility around the schedule — because parenting never pauses.
Join the party: team building and company events people talk about for months.
Unlock Cyber City: coffee bar, open gyms, kids’ room, music room, massage chairs — our Vilnius HQ is yours to enjoy.
